clips.linkedin:
Give AI your twenty most important advice pages and it will list which citation features each one lacks.

This week SISTRIX compared pages that AI search cited with pages from the same sites that it didn't. Tables of contents, Article schema and author boxes went with more citations. For a marketing lead, that is a checklist for pages you already own, with no new budget line.

Give your AI assistant the URL list and the features to check, such as a table of contents, a question as a heading and a visible update date. It hands you a grid of which pages have what, with fixes ranked by how many features each page is missing.

The podcast voices are AI-generated.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/sistrix-ai-citation-study-geo-tactics/
clips.text: Right, so what do we hand over? Get AI on this. First, score your twenty most important advice pages against the study's list. Give your AI the URL list and the features to check, a table of contents, five or more section headings, a question as a heading, a table with a header row, an author box with a photo and a visible update date. It hands you a grid of which pages have what, and the fixes ranked by how many features each page is missing.
